question.text:
Among the following cations, the number of cations which will give characteristic precipitate in their identification tests with $\mathrm{K}_4\left[\mathrm{Fe}(\mathrm{CN})_6\right]$ is _____.
$\mathrm{Cu}^{2+}, \mathrm{Fe}^{3+}, \mathrm{Ba}^{2+}, \mathrm{Ca}^{2+}, \mathrm{NH}_4^{+}, \mathrm{Mg}^{2+}, \mathrm{Zn}^{2+}$

solution.text: $\mathrm{Cu}^{2+}, \mathrm{Ca}^{2+} \& \mathrm{Zn}^{2+}$ will form precipitate with $\mathrm{K}_4\left[\mathrm{Fe}(\mathrm{CN})_6\right] . \mathrm{Fe}^{3+}$ forms coloured solution
